# Settings search by a look's name and the tooltip of a cut-off description (it wraps onto several lines and stays on
# screen). The mouse sits in the middle of the window, so the tooltip belongs to whichever row is there; each search
# puts a different long description near it. German and Russian at GUI scale 4 (320x180) and 3.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f script=.github/checks/settings-tips.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6
lang de_de
sleep 15
guiscale 4
gui 0
sleep 3
search Verträumt
sleep 2
shot look-search-de
search Höhlen
sleep 2
shot tips-de-caves
search Verlauf
sleep 2
shot tips-de-history
search Songs
sleep 2
shot tips-de-songs
guiscale 3
sleep 2
search Höhlen
sleep 2
shot tips-de-caves-g3
close
lang ru_ru
sleep 15
guiscale 4
gui 0
sleep 3
search Грёзы
sleep 2
shot look-search-ru
search пещер
sleep 2
shot tips-ru-caves
close
